headline: Kai, a second strike on Riyadh's airport in three days killed at least twelve, and Trump now says America may join the fight.
subline: Washington is buying Russian diesel, the ten-year sits at 5.24 percent heading into CPI week, and the big banks report Tuesday.
asof: Sunday edition · strip is Friday's close (Oct 9), bitcoin live early Sunday · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Bond market dark Monday; banks open Tuesday
items.sentence: The S&P 500 finished the week up 1.2 percent at 7,811.54, bond trading pauses Monday for the holiday, and earnings season ramps up Tuesday with the major banks, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: CPI week arrives with hike odds at 84%
items.sentence: September CPI and PPI land this week with traders pricing an 84 percent chance of at least one Fed hike by December, while spot gold firmed to $4,194.50 on Friday, up 1.5 percent, per Kitco.

items.title: Oil holds $91.85 despite the diesel deal
items.sentence: WTI settled Friday at $91.85, up 0.39 percent, as hurricane-related Gulf shut-ins offset easing Iran fears and the Russian diesel supply announced mid-session, per Market Scholars.

items.title: Bitcoin sits near $83,000 into the week
items.sentence: The coin trades at $82,992 early Sunday, up 0.3 percent over 24 hours but still down 2.5 percent on the week, per CoinGecko.

items.title: Second Riyadh airport strike kills at least 12
items.sentence: Saturday's strike on King Khalid International killed at least 12 people, an American among them, and wounded 309, and unlike Thursday's attack the Houthis have not claimed it, per CBS News.

items.title: Trump says U.S. may join the Houthi fight
items.sentence: Trump said Saturday his administration would "look at" joining Saudi Arabia's campaign against the Houthis, while repeating that he will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterms, per CBS News.

items.title: Washington buys Russian diesel; Kyiv calls it weak
items.sentence: Treasury issued a temporary license for Putin's promised 300,000 tonnes of diesel after U.S. pump prices hit a record $6.52 a gallon in September — a deal Zelenskyy called "a weak decision by strong partners," per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Tehran promises an answer on Hormuz within days
items.sentence: Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran will respond to the U.S. position on its seven-day plan to reopen the strait in the "next few days," as Iranian media reported fresh explosions — possibly sea mines — in the waterway, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Isaias pushes inland; at least four dead
items.sentence: At least four people are dead as the storm pushes further inland across the Southeast following its Gulf Coast landfall, per CNN's live coverage.

items.title: GPT-6 and a visual UI reach every tier
items.sentence: OpenAI is rolling GPT-6 out across all ChatGPT tiers alongside an interface that renders charts, buttons and forms inside replies, per TechCrunch.

items.title: Apple books October 27 for a touchscreen MacBook
items.sentence: Bloomberg reporting relayed by 9to5Mac points to a touch-screen MacBook Pro and a new iPad mini headlining an October 27 Apple event.

items.title: OpenAI shuts an Iranian propaganda network
items.sentence: The Washington Post reported that Iranian operatives used ChatGPT to plant AI-generated articles in U.S. publications before OpenAI banned the operation, per AI Weekly's roundup.

items.title: OpenAI opens a Decisions API beta
items.sentence: The public beta is built on GPT-6 Luna and priced at $0.10 per million input tokens, per AI Weekly's roundup.
